tickets.title: Prepare Pre-Clearance Narrative for Sale
tickets.text: Prepare a pre‑clearance narrative for Selene Velvetreed outlining the proposed sale size, liquidity purpose, destination account, and confirming no material nonpublic information, to be reviewed by Apricot Compass Advisory.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-06 to prepare pre-clearance narrative covering proposed sale size, liquidity purpose, account destination, and no material nonpublic information to Apricot Compass Advisory.

tickets.title: Reconcile Velvet Acorn Custody Share Feed
tickets.text: Reconcile the 18,200‑share feed from Velvet Acorn Custody with the 19,050 vested shares reported by Tin Sparrow Robotics for Selene Velvetreed.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-10 to reconcile Velvet Acorn Custody’s 18,200-share feed with the 19,050 vested shares in the employer report.
